svg.text: Flow 05 Online payment with QR Ph (partial)
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
Ask for the receipt up to
• PARTIAL: this path is coded, but production has no PayMongo keys, so today every order takes the “not set up” branch and is paid at the counter. The
success page's code comment says it hasn't been tested against a live PayMongo sandbox.
• UNCLEAR: a customer who cancels on PayMongo's page is sent to /checkout?order=…&cancelled=1, but the checkout page doesn't read that address and the
order was already emptied, so it shows “Your order is empty”. The unpaid order stays in Orders awaiting payment (19) until staff cancel it.
• UNCLEAR: if the payment isn't confirmed within the 5 checks, the receipt shows the counter wording “Please pay at the counter to confirm your order.”
• When PayMongo isn't set up (501) the server also saves the payment as Pay at counter. After too many attempts (429) the payment keeps its online
method, and Orders awaiting payment shows it as “Counter (chose QR Ph, but online payment didn't start)”.
• A webhook can arrive more than once; the paid check makes a repeat delivery do nothing.
